caption:
If you're reading this instead of sleeping

Allah is the One who made the night a garment for you and made sleep for rest. Put the phone down tonight and take the rest He made for you.

Surah Al-Furqaan 25:47

Send this to the friend who is always online at 2am.

#sleep #nightroutine #surahfurqan #muslimreminders

Recitation: Maher Al-Muaiqly
